crossRefs.note: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel;” which is…
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

translations.web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
translations.bsb: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
translations.kjv: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
translations.asv: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.
